450 likes, 16 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 28, 2026: "Delhi ke beech me ek aisi jagah chupi hai jo dikhti hai filmo jaisi, par hai 800 saal purani... 😱

Ye hai Agrasen Ki Baoli - Hailey Road, Connaught Place ke paas.

14th century ki ye baoli 108 seedhiyon wali hai, aur kehte hain yaha ka paani kabhi kala pad jata tha, log ise Delhi ki sabse haunted jagah bhi maante hain.

PK film se lekar Sultan tak, kitni filmo ki shooting yaha hui hai, aur shaam ko jab light jalti hai na, tab ye jagah sabse zyada khoobsurat lagti hai.

Entry bilkul free hai, timing subah 9 se shaam 5:30 tak, nearest metro Barakhamba Road.

Agar Delhi me ho aur yaha nahi aaye to kya hi aaye? Apne us dost ko tag karo jo darta hai yaha aane se 👻👇

agrasen ki baoli delhi | hailey road delhi | haunted place in delhi | delhi hidden gems | connaught place delhi

#agrasenkibaoli #haileyroad #haunteddelhi #delhihiddengems #delhitravelblogger".
